<p align="center"><strong>Ending 06 of 06 - The October Keeper</strong></p>

<p align="center"><small><strong>Inventory:</strong> Brass key &middot; Moonseed &middot; Copper coil &middot; Star lantern &middot; Sky bearing &middot; Beacon restored &middot; Black cat companion</small></p>


<p align="center">You let Elias and Ada follow the other lights. Then you return to the workshop and turn the brass key in the inside lock. Briar House settles around you.</p>

<p align="center">Your cat takes the chair beside yours. It watches the door while you write the names of everyone who escaped.</p>

<p align="center">Outside the window, the first of November never arrives. A keeper remains on this side of the threshold. Once a year the town will see your lantern in the trees.</p>

<p align="center">THE OCTOBER KEEPER - The names are free. You have chosen the watch. On the next Halloween, twelve knocks sound at your door. You do not answer.</p>
